title: Hira tsara, hira.
meterSource: No numerical meter is printed in the supplied photographs. 3/4 is provisional: one three-cell printed unit is treated as one measure. Underlined note-group durations are not independently verified.

notationConventions.raw: The SATB tonic sol-fa lines were manually transcribed from the two source photographs.
notationConventions.colon: Separates printed rhythmic cells; does not by itself specify time signature.
notationConventions.barline: Each printed bar divider is preserved as a measure boundary; no extra | character was invented.
notationConventions.dash: Sustained/continued pitch. Long notes may continue across measure boundaries.
notationConventions.underline: Some original short-note group underlines are not fully encoded in playback.

issues: The source does not print numerical time signature or BPM; 3/4 and 90 BPM are editorial playback assumptions.
Underlined subdivisions and register choices require musical review before treating exported MIDI as definitive.
Syllable-to-note alignment is simplified for the app, though full verse text is included.
